issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation says 'vào... trước các ngươi' (will enter... before/ahead of you), but the Greek text 'προαγουσιν υμας' means 'will precede you' or 'will go before you' in a sense of priority/precedence. While similar, the Vietnamese phrasing 'trước các ngươi' can be interpreted as a temporal sequence (before you) rather than the specific sense of precedence intended by 'proagousin'.
